gust.description: Pushes objects or enemies with a sudden burst of Aetherwind.

veil_glimmer.description: Creates a brief illusion using Moonveil magic.

dragon_scarred_pass.name: Dragon-Scarred Mountain Pass
dragon_scarred_pass.description: An ancient ridge torn open long ago by the fall of a colossal dragon. The rocks still hum with emberlight scars, and winds carry faint whispers of dormant power.

shattered_outlook.name: Shattered Outlook
shattered_outlook.description: A cliffside overlook where pieces of the mountain were blown apart by ancient magic. The wind pressure here shifts unpredictably.

whispering_fissure.name: Whispering Fissure
whispering_fissure.description: A deep crack in the earth glowing with submerged arcane runes. Soft whispers echo from below, speaking in a forgotten draconic tongue.

echoing_vale.name: Echoing Vale
echoing_vale.description: A valley where sound behaves unnaturally, bouncing and warping through the air. Travelers report hearing voices from their past.

mysterious_wanderer.name: Arthon Veyl
mysterious_wanderer.description: A calm, enigmatic traveler with pale markings that glow faintly under moonlight. Speaks indirectly, as if he knows more than he says.

awakening.name: Awakening of the Aether
awakening.description: Discover the truth behind the arcane disturbance at the Dragon-Scarred Pass.
